theorems.statement: ∀ (A : ℝ), 1 < A → ∃ φ : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 φ ∧ Antitone φ ∧ (∀ u, 0 ≤ φ u ∧ φ u ≤ 1) ∧ (∀ u, u ≤ 1 → φ u = 1) ∧ (∀ u, A ≤ u → φ u = 0) ∧ (∀ u, deriv φ u ≤ 0) ∧ (∀ u, deriv φ u ≠ 0 → 1 < u ∧ u < A)
